address: rue de la Casquette 5, Liège, 4000, Belgium
bio: You will immediately feel at home at the Enoteca, which is depicted by tightly packed tables, a friendly vibe and cheerful service. Food lovers have been flocking here for over thirty years, lured by the unbeatable value for money and the text-book perfect Italian nosh. Farfalle al dente with fresh shrimp, preserved lemons and a knockout tomato sauce – authenticity is the goal! Order the chef’s daily special with your eyes closed and don’t forget the enticing wine list....
